description: Owner only: plan a Dev/Prod data assignment change and review the data, files, deployments and database logins it keeps or removes. isolate_prod_keeps_data keeps existing data with Prod and gives Dev an empty area; isolate_dev_keeps_data keeps it with Dev and gives Prod an empty area; share_prod_keeps_data keeps Prod and removes Dev-only data, files and deployment; reset_dev removes isolated Dev data, files and deployment while preserving secrets and access mode and renewing a protected share link. New databases appear on the next deployment; no data is copied and ordinary usage rates apply. The returned plan ETag and confirmation token bind this exact change for ten minutes.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: project_data_plan
